title: Seagrove Beach "Coco Flamingo" 3880 East County Highway 30-A #301
h1: Seagrove Beach "Coco Flamingo" 3880 East County Highway 30-A #301
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- Gulf-front community pool (not heated)- Newly renovated - 4 adult bikes- Parking for 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Coco Flamingo promises fabulous Gulf views and fantastic beach access! This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Gulf-front condo sleeps 10 guests in laid-back Seagrove Beach. Enjoy days of fishing, paddleboarding, or kayaking on Eastern Lake, or discover the rare coastal fauna with a hike through Deer Lake State Park. Conveniently located, multiple eateries are within walking distance, including local favorites Café Thirty-A and The Perfect Pig. When not exploring, guests will love savoring sunny days lounging on the Gulf-facing balcony, stretching out beside the community pool, or strolling to the beach—access is right off the building’s pool deck!Bright and beautifully adorned, this charming single-story condo perfectly combines glamorous modern elements with vintage-style charm. Sparkling KitchenAid appliances and quartz countertops are featured in the open kitchen, alongside a wraparound breakfast bar with 5 sleek acrylic bar stools. Mix cocktails at the mirrored wet bar on the side for a lavish happy hour, then gather at the elegant 6-person dining table for a delicious group dinner. In the living space, a cream sofa and 2 colorful, patterned armchairs offer plush comfort for relaxing beside the glorious Gulf view. Venture onto the spacious balcony to recline on the cushioned lounger or brunch at the 4-seat table as sunlight plays across the turquoise water below. The primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and Gulf view features access to the balcony—imagine waking each morning to tranquil waves. Rest easy in 2 guest bedrooms, both featuring queen beds, with 1 bedroom also offering French door access to the outside. Kids will love spending nights together in the bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.With a community pool and beach access steps away, Coco Flamingo offers a marvelous Seagrove Beach getaway. Easily explore thanks to parking for 2 vehicles, or hop on the 4 complimentary adult bikes to visit nearby Seaside and WaterColor via the Timpoochee Trail. Book today for an unforgettable 30A vacation!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Jetted Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
